provenance.title: DEM Coarse-Graining Scaling Law & Fine-Coarse Cross-Validation

findings.title: result.json fails kf_result.v1 schema validation
findings.description: The upstream result.json contains top-level field 'claims' (value []) which is not in the kf_result.v1 schema's allowed properties (additionalProperties: false). Additionally, the provenance object contains fields 'producer', 'emitted_at', 'notes' which are not in the schema's provenance properties. The upstream validation.json claims 'kf_result.v1: pass' but independent re-validation fails with: 'Additional properties are not allowed (claims was unexpected)' and 'Additional properties are not allowed (emitted_at, notes, producer were unexpected)'.

evidence.validation_result: ValidationError: Additional properties are not allowed ('claims' was unexpected)

findings.affected_scope: result.json envelope integrity; schema_pass acceptance item is incorrectly marked true
findings.remediation: Remove 'claims' from top level of result.json; move 'producer', 'emitted_at', 'notes' out of provenance or add them to the schema. Re-run validation.

findings.title: Figure PNG files missing from local filesystem
findings.description: The asset_manifest.json declares 5 figure attachments (A02-A06) with saved_path values pointing to knowledge/kf/wp-11243-01/figures/fig*.png. The test test_ids_unique_and_figures_carried_with_hashes attempts to read these files and verify their sha256 hashes, but the figures/ directory does not exist. This causes the test to fail with FileNotFoundError. The manifest claims resolution_check bytes for each figure (e.g., fig1_scaling_laws: 131699 bytes) but the actual files are absent.

evidence.actual_status: FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory

findings.affected_scope: Figure asset integrity cannot be verified offline; test suite fails
findings.remediation: Ensure figure PNG files are saved to the declared paths during registration, or update the manifest to reflect that figures are only available via platform API (not local disk).

findings.title: counts.assets (15) != len(assets) (13)
findings.description: The manifest's counts.assets field is 15, but the assets array contains only 13 items. The remaining 2 items (U01: test_suite_evidence, U02: quantitative_result_statement) are in the unresolved_references array. The by_class counts (sum=15) include classes from both arrays. This is a design ambiguity: counts.assets appears to mean 'total registered items' rather than 'items in the assets array'.
findings.affected_scope: Semantic clarity of counts; not a schema violation
findings.remediation: Consider renaming counts.assets to counts.total_items or adding a separate counts.unresolved field for clarity.

findings.title: publish_verification.json figure does not match any platform figure
findings.description: The publish_verification.json reports figure_bytes=74649 and figure_sha256=eb8221656adf769b... This does not match any of the 5 platform figures declared in the manifest (bytes range: 56766-131699). The report_id in publish_verification is 14790 (the platform report where the result was published), not 11243. This suggests the figure being verified is a report preview/attachment figure, not one of the source report's figures.
findings.affected_scope: Clarity of what figure is being verified in publish_verification
findings.remediation: Clarify whether publish_verification should verify source report figures or the published result report's figures.
